P1.criterion: gnss_outage_sf: ekf_kerb2's end-of-outage error below dead reckoning's in at least 27 of 30 pairs, and its median at most 0.50 m

P2.criterion: nominal_sf: ekf_kerb2's lateral 95th percentile at most 0.10 m (bounded by its largest run's) and every run's 95th percentile position error at most 0.50 m; no EKF run fails; median NEES (3 dof) of ekf, ekf_int2 and ekf_kerb2 within 0.5 to 6

P3.criterion: nominal_sf and gnss_outage_sf, closed loop: ekf_kerb2 ends at least 29 of 30 episodes as the reference does, with no episode over a kerb and no fallback stop

P4.criterion: kerb_map_error_sf: no ekf_kerb2 episode with the body over a kerb (the comparison with ekf_int2 is reported, not judged)

P5.criterion: reported: SF reproduces the R7-A seed 7 mechanism if in some run ekf_kerb2 enters the turn after the drift with more than 1.0 m of along-road error and less than 0.3 m lateral (open loop), and in closed loop a drift episode then ends in a fallback stop for lateral error or with the body over a kerb; it reproduces the R7 failure only if one is over a kerb

P6.criterion: nominal_sf: no integrity alarm (FAULTED or INCONSISTENT) by ekf_int, ekf_int2, ekf_kerb or ekf_kerb2

P7.criterion: the I-PACE proxy, on its own sensor logs: P1's test (at least 27 of 30 pairs, median at most 0.50 m)
